name: mm-mcp
description: Read, search and post in Mattermost as yourself, through the mm-mcp server. Log in once with mm-mcp login, single sign-on included. Needs mm-mcp installed: https://vriesdemichael.github.io/mm-mcp/installation/

mm_url.title: Mattermost address
mm_url.description: The address you open Mattermost at, such as https://chat.example.com.

mm_token.title: Token
mm_token.description: A personal access token or a bot token. Leave it empty after logging in once with mm-mcp login, which keeps your session in your system's credential store.

allow_writes.title: Allow posting
allow_writes.description: Offer the tools that post and change things. Claude Code's own approval of each call decides, and mm-mcp checks what each states before it acts.

elicitation_opt_in.title: mm-mcp asks as well
elicitation_opt_in.description: Have mm-mcp ask you too, through a question Claude Code shows, before each change others see. A convenience where it shows it, not a safeguard: in the Claude desktop app's Code tab, Claude Code declines the question without showing it, so leave this off there.

force_human_in_the_loop_in_claude_code.title: Force a human in the loop in Claude Code
force_human_in_the_loop_in_claude_code.description: Not with mm-mcp asks as well: Claude Code asks you before every change others see, in every permission mode, whatever its rules allow. An agent cannot post on its own while it is on.
